query: SELECT u.open_id, u.display_name, u.primary_animal_id, ao.animal_id, ao.status, a.name as animal_name, a.slug as animal_slug FROM users u LEFT JOIN animalOwnerships ao ON u.open_id = ao.owner_open_id LEFT JOIN animals a ON ao.animal_id = a.id ORDER BY u.open_id, ao.animal_id;
